test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He is not __friendly__ with him in the office.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Option 2**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Friendly**' means kind and pleasant; affable; genial (दोस्ताना)

 
 
• **Example**- Sam has chosen people that he is **friendly **with and that he can talk to.
 
 
 
• **"Hostile" **showing or feeling opposition or dislike; unfriendly(शत्रुतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example- **Russia and China were openly **hostile **to the plan.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of '**friendly**' is '**hostile**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Hostile.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Gregarious(**सुसामाजिक): fond of company; sociable.

 
 
• **Example- **He's a **gregarious **man who's always good company.
 
 
 
• **Intelligent(**बुद्धिमान): having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level.
 
 
• **Example- **An **intelligent **person would not have needed to ask that question!
 
 
 
• **Revel(**आनंद लेना)**: **Enjoy oneself in a lively and noisy way, especially with drinking and dancing.
 
 
• **Example- **There’s a time to **revel** in frozen drinks, and that time is now.
